description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kumbuka, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530175
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership details, property boundaries, encumbrances, and legal determinations regarding land titles. The content focuses entirely on land and property matters, specifically the formal registration and declaration of land titles by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette.
